newsitem.title: USA: U.S. equity options Nov volume up 8.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: U.S. equity options Nov volume up 8.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: U.S. equity options volume in November rose 8.4 percent to 16,571,333 contracts from 15,294,779 in November 1995, the Options Industry Council (OIC) said Wednesday.
Volume for the first 11 months of the year rose 12.6 percent to 180,693,189 contracts, from 160,523,076 contracts in the first nine months of 1995 and topped the record 1995 total of 174,380,236.
Average daily volume in November was 828,567 contracts, up from 728,323 in November 1995. ((Derivatives desk 3124088750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com))
